p168_D_original_source_check.scope: Two distinct physical receptions; exact ciphertext equality does not remove their shared six-glyph source irregularity.

negative_or_prior_only_effects: The short native 184-coordinate p166 A3 diagnostic gains numeric labels in otherwise garbled output; its adopted 204-coordinate source-linked edition is already covered by the older military interpretation.
Native p167 A3 has VF at date position 39, hence 6; the existing shared edited stream separately adopts observed 9 from p166. This raw consequence is not an extra edited-position gain.
Native p163 A17 has VF at position 17, hence 6; its older word edition separately repairs that pair to separator X.
The p163 A18 corps VF pair is created by an existing source repair; it is not an originally observed new pair.
Native p167 D has VF at position 77, hence 6; its existing word edition separately repairs that pair to T.
The p166 B2 priority digit uses a coordinate supplied from p171; it is not a newly complete original p166 pair.
Existing courier, military, withdrawal, Marineamt and postal conditional layers are credited and not recounted.
limits: The square assignment still depends on the same-reference interpretation. Both values are replayed for every scanned occurrence.
The inventory is a frozen bounded audit, not an assertion about new sources added after its checkpoint.
The p168 D native transcript equals p159 C but remains a separate physical reception. Their common six-letter group and the earlier chosen exclusion stay explicit.
Replaying a source diagnostic does not make its garbled text a recovered historical message.
